title: Facial nerve: CN VII anatomy
description: Track facial motor branches, taste, lacrimation and salivation through the temporal bone and parotid gland.

questions.question: What does the facial nerve control?
questions.answer: Cranial nerve VII supplies muscles of facial expression and also carries taste and parasympathetic fibers through specific branches.

questions.question: Does the facial nerve provide most facial skin sensation?
questions.answer: No. Most facial skin sensation travels in branches of the trigeminal nerve; the facial nerve is mainly known for its motor supply to facial expression.

questions.question: What is the facial motor nucleus?
questions.answer: Motor cell bodies in pons send axons looping around abducens nucleus before exit. Function: Controls muscles of facial expression.

questions.question: Where is the internal acoustic meatus located?
questions.answer: Temporal-bone canal shared by CN VII, CN VIII and labyrinthine artery. Function: Conveys nerve toward facial canal.

questions.question: What is the function of the greater petrosal nerve?
questions.answer: Function: Supports lacrimal and nasal/palatine gland secretion. Carries preganglionic fibers toward pterygopalatine ganglion.
